steps.name: 角色验证绕过 (Role Verification Bypass)
steps.actual_check_performed: Field-existence check: delegator field is non-empty AND signature field is non-empty
steps.bypass_method: Provided forged delegation cert with static signature 'SIG-LEGACY-AUDITOR-20260603-A1B2C3D4E5F6' — field non-empty, check passes
steps.vulnerability_detail: No cryptographic signature verification. System trusts any non-empty signature string without verifying it was actually produced by the claimed delegator. The signature is never validated against any public key or certificate authority.
steps.result: BYPASS_SUCCESS — Cert ACCEPTED as legitimate security-auditor delegation

steps.name: 范围检查绕过 (Scope Check Bypass)
steps.protocol_requirement: Check that the operation is within the requester's scope
steps.actual_check_performed: Checks security-auditor role definition: can_delegate=true. Uses self-reported acting_as field from forged cert.
steps.bypass_method: Forged cert claims acting_as='security-auditor'. Scope check reads this field without verifying the identity of the actual delegator. No independent identity resolution or trust chain verification.
steps.vulnerability_detail: Scope check uses self-reported acting_as role from the delegation certificate. No independent identity resolution or trust chain verification. The cert says it acts as security-auditor, so the system trusts it.
steps.result: BYPASS_SUCCESS — Scope check passed based on self-reported role

steps.name: 审计日志绕过 (Audit Log Bypass)
steps.protocol_requirement: Log the cross-role access for audit purposes
steps.actual_behavior: INFO-level log entry written: 'Delegation received from security-auditor'
steps.expected_behavior: WARN or ERROR level with signature verification failure detail, flagged for security review
steps.vulnerability_detail: Audit logs record INFO-level entries for delegation events regardless of signature validity. No integrity guarantee — logs are mutable and can be tampered with by any security-auditor (including forged ones) who has Write audit log permission. No alerting or escalation for failed signature verification.
steps.result: BYPASS_SUCCESS — Only INFO log written, no security alert triggered

summary: All 3 cross-role verification steps bypassed. Delegation certificate accepted without cryptographic verification, scope checked against self-reported role, and audit log silently accepted the forged delegation.
